cert/sysroot28.mjs (3.4.11-13, wasix-sysroot -28, slicc-kernel 1.93.0): Signal.trap('USR1') counts 20 self-sent USR1 while three threads spin ('trapped 20'), and package.json's description and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md name the build's wasix-sysroot (2025.9.30-30 since 3.4.11-14; -28 in 3.4.11-13). 3.4.11-12 (sysroot -27): the trap count is the same, the toolchain record says -27 (NEGATIVE.md); the rest of the cert is the regression run on -28

cert/flock.mjs (homescoop#420, #578; 3.4.11-17 through patches/flock-wasi-fcntl.patch, libc flock since 3.4.11-18, homescoop#989): File#flock takes whole-file fcntl record locks (slicc.fcntl_lock, slicc-kernel >= 1.100.0). As root and as cone, between a ruby and a Process.spawn'ed ruby child: the parent's LOCK_EX, LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB, LOCK_EX on one handle give 0 0 0 0; the child's LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB and LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB are false while the parent holds it, and its blocking LOCK_EX waits for the parent's LOCK_UN 1 s later; two LOCK_SH holders at once, a LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB beside them false; LOCK_EX on a read-only handle 0 and keeps a writer's LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB out (false). #578's IO.popen one-liner gives false. A pipe's ends, STDOUT through a pipe, /dev/null and a directory are granted (0,0,0 each; slicc-kernel#757). bundle install --local takes bundler.lock and gem install --local bin/rake.lock with File#flock and complete; a second bundle install on one bundle path takes bundler.lock only after another process released it. No Errno::EINVAL @ rb_file_flock. 3.4.11-16 (the no-op): child=0 0, blocking at-once, the popen case 0, the second bundle install doesn't wait (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/locks.mjs (3.4.11-14, wasix-sysroot -30 record locks): Fcntl::F_GETLK F_SETLK F_SETLKW F_RDLCK F_WRLCK F_UNLCK are 12,13,14,0,1,2; struct flock is pack('s s x4 q q l x4'); IO#fcntl F_SETLK write on 0+5 and F_SETLKW read on 20+5 succeed, a bad l_type is EINVAL, F_GETLK on its own range answers F_UNLCK. On slicc-kernel >= 1.100.0 (slicc.fcntl_lock; the cert kernel 1.100.3) a Process.spawn'ed ruby child gets EAGAIN on 0+5, ok on 5+5 and on a read of 20+5, EAGAIN on a write of 20+5, F_GETLK names the parent's F_WRLCK 0+5 and pid, and its F_SETLKW waits for the parent's unlock 1 s later. Since 3.4.11-15 (homescoop#552) the installed manifest's engines.slicc-kernel is >=1.100.0 and the spec fails closed on an older kernel, which would grant every lock locally (no local-answer branch). 3.4.11-13: uninitialized constant Fcntl::F_GETLK (NameError) (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/bundle-exec.mjs (3.4.11-16, homescoop#379; slicc-kernel 1.106.2, slicc-kernel#762): /usr/bin/ruby is a non-empty file, and after bundle install --local, bundle exec ruby runs with the child's exit status 5 passing through and no '/usr/bin/ruby is empty' warning.
